summary.headline: Chapter 46: Lord of the Hour
summary.text: Astrological judgments about bodily health, love, authority, illness, and temperance according to a planet’s house and its conjunction with malefics or fortunes. An editorial notice introduces appended chapters, followed by Chapter 46 on the lord of the hour and its shared significations with the lord of the ascendant.
